caption: Chat Ships It
text: Chat Ships It. Viewers redeem Ship a Feature. OpenAI Codex builds a sandboxed Twitch overlay widget — live on stream.

caption: Open the live demo.
text: Here is the real live app on Vercel. We open chat-ships-it.vercel.app, then click into the interactive stream demo — DEMO_MODE, no Twitch Client ID required.

caption: Redeem. !ship. Codex builds.
text: A simulated viewer redeems a rubber duck that quacks on LUL. A mod clicks ship. Watch Codex plan, stream the diff, and flip the test light green. The widget hot-loads onto the overlay, credited to Morgan. Chat types LUL — and the duck quacks.

caption: Ship confetti. Trigger a raid.
text: Next, Avery redeems raid confetti. Ship again. Codex builds in the sandbox. Then we fire a raid and a cheer — confetti bursts on the simulated stream. Safe by design: no network inside the iframe.

caption: Dashboard and OBS overlay.
text: The streamer dashboard and the transparent OBS overlay at slash overlay slash northbridge complete the loop — queue, build panel, and widgets ready for a real browser source.

caption: Try it yourself.
text: We built the product with Codex, and Codex is the game mechanic. Try the demo at chat-ships-it.vercel.app. Star the repo on GitHub. Chat Ships It, by Green Robin Labs, for the Codex x TwitchCon Hackathon.
